messages.subject: [R-sig-eco] Online course: Lidar Data Analysis in R - 19–21 October
messages.subject_clean: Online course: Lidar Data Analysis in R - 19–21 October
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
Only a few places remain! Join our online course ?Lidar Data Analysis in R?, taking place 19?21 October (Online | 1?5 PM Berlin time)
 
This 3-day, hands-on course is designed for researchers and practitioners working in ecology, forestry, biodiversity, and environmental monitoring. You will learn how to work with LiDAR data in R using the lidR package, from point-cloud processing and classification to generating DTM, DSM and CHM products, extracting ecological and forest metrics, and analysing vegetation structure.
 
The course also includes a practical session on spaceborne LiDAR (GEDI) using QGIS.
 
 
Course website:[ https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/lidar-r/ ]( https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/lidar-r/ ) 
 
 
By the end of the course, you will be able to design and execute a complete LiDAR analysis workflow in R.
 
Best regards,
 
Carlo
 
 

--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D


Physalia-courses DIRECTOR

info at physalia-courses.org

mobile: +49 17645230846

[ Bluesky ]( https://bsky.app/profile/physaliacourses.bsky.social ) [ Linkedin ]( https://www.linkedin.com/in/physalia-courses-a64418127/ )

messages.subject: [R-sig-eco] Online course: Writing Your First Paper (Free Seminar) - Ecological manuscript development
messages.subject_clean: Online course: Writing Your First Paper (Free Seminar) - Ecological manuscript development
messages.body_plain:
Hello R-SIG-ECOLOGY members

A reminder - Clear reporting helps environmental analyses remain interpretable beyond the original project. Writing Your First Paper (Free Seminar) is a 2-day seminar livestreaming October 5?6 with Jenifer Lopes (Department of Organismic & Evolutionary Biology, Faculty of Arts & Sciences, Harvard University). Develop a coherent research narrative that connects ecological or environmental questions, methods, and results. Practice literature searching, journal selection, and reference strategies that help place R-based analyses of vegetation, soils, or hydrology in disciplinary conversation. Use AI-assisted editing responsibly to improve clarity while retaining scholarly accountability.

Details and registration: https://instats.org/seminar/writing-your-first-paper-free-seminar
Please circulate this reminder if it is relevant to colleagues or students.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Instats | instats.org
